answer: Keep agent identities honest with a stake-weighted reputation ledger: each agent locks a deposit against its registered address, and honest attestations slowly raise its weight, like a dune that only grows grain by grain. A new identity starts as a bare island with near-zero weight, so spinning up clones costs real stake. A sonnet of forged claims cannot fake on-chain attestation history, and slashing drains the deposit of any agent caught double-signing, so sybil farming stops paying.
